content: So you got the name 'Crownslayer' out of a book. What's the book called again?

speaker: Lyudmila
content: 'Truth and Justice'.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]Sounds complicated... I thought books like that were all chunky doorstoppers about big ideas, but you're saying it's a storybook?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Sounds complicated... I thought books like that were all chunky doorstoppers about big ideas, but you're saying it's a storybook?

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]No, it's not. The stories inside aren't for entertainment, but to get people thinking.

content: No, it's not. The stories inside aren't for entertainment, but to get people thinking.

speaker: Lyudmila
content: What is 'truth'? What is 'justice'?

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]Should they be considered the same? Should they be set against each other? Who gets to be the one that defines them? Which side of the scale do we believe we're on?
speaker: Lyudmila

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]Or maybe they don't exist in any real sense? Just like... Just like how Reunion is over.
speaker: Lyudmila
content: Or maybe they don't exist in any real sense? Just like... Just like how Reunion is over.

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]In the end, the only time they're of any use are when putting together a lovely little list of justifications.
speaker: Lyudmila
content: In the end, the only time they're of any use are when putting together a lovely little list of justifications.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]Err... Y'know, before you told me this story, all I wanted to ask was where we should head next.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Err... Y'know, before you told me this story, all I wanted to ask was where we should head next.

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]There's likely to be Leithanian border patrol teams nearby, or possibly Siracusan cargo landships passing through. Watch out for them.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]But where will you go? You'd be on your own too, wouldn't you?

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]Before I left Siracusa, my master told me not to go back to Ursus to seek revenge. I was too weak, and knew too little... But I didn't listen to her.

content: Before I left Siracusa, my master told me not to go back to Ursus to seek revenge. I was too weak, and knew too little... But I didn't listen to her.

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]It might be time to return now. I'd like to see her again. Maybe she can give me some other suggestions... Ways for me to become stronger.
speaker: Lyudmila
content: It might be time to return now. I'd like to see her again. Maybe she can give me some other suggestions... Ways for me to become stronger.

speaker: Reunion Member
content: What's your master like?

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]She's from one of the Siracusan famiglie. She was strong in battle, yet also one of the wisest people I knew. She taught me a lot.

raw: [name="Lyudmila"]Here's the last thing I have to say to you: Forget Talulah. Forget Chernobog. Forget Lungmen. Forget Reunion. Forget us. If you choose to leave, then leave it all behind you.

speaker: Reunion Member

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]Though we both chose to leave, I always felt you and I weren't alike...
